title: A wiki that changes every week
summary: Choose RAG, a long prompt, or fine-tuning for fresh cited facts.

choices.text: Put the entire wiki in the prompt. A long context is always cheaper than an index, and a model cannot miss a page that is inside its window.
Raise the decoding temperature so the model is more willing to recall the wiki from pretraining.
Fine-tune the base model on this week's wiki so the facts live in the weights, then quote from memory.
Retrieval-augmented generation: index the wiki, fetch a few passages per question, and answer from those passages so the quote has a source.
